Featured course · Cyber Security Academy

Cybersecurity for the Agentic Era

The model may propose an action. Independently enforced policy decides whether it happens.

  • 28 lessons, from threat modelling to incident response, a capstone, and a frontier-research module
  • Tools and MCP, identity, memory, multi-agent trust, sandboxing, runtime enforcement
  • A lab where you write the security design and test plans for your own agent system, practice tools and a local kit to run example attacks, and a certificate you can verify

03Certificate

A certificate you can verify and share

When you meet the criteria you can claim a certificate with its own credential ID and a public page anyone can open to verify it. Add it to LinkedIn in one click, share it, or save it as a PDF.

To earn it

  1. Finish every lesson
  2. Complete every lab step and pass its health checks
  3. Answer at least 70% of the check questions correctly, on the first try or in review

What you get

  • A credential ID and a public page that confirms it
  • Add to LinkedIn in one click
  • Share on LinkedIn, X or Facebook, or copy the link
  • Save as a PDF

Intellica certificates show that you finished this course, as reported by your own browser and checked against the course's completion rules. The record is self-reported: it is not proctored, and your lab work is not marked by Intellica. They are not accredited qualifications and do not lead to any outside certification.

04How we teach

Every course follows the same loop

Learn from a clear example

See the standard before you practise. Lessons break complex work into steps, with examples you can inspect and adapt.

Build something real

Apply each skill to a practical artefact, design or workflow—not just a quiz or a promise.

Know where you stand

Course pages distinguish available content from planned work and explain what each certificate does and does not represent.

Intellica publishes the scope, prerequisites and current status of each learning path. You can decide what fits your goals before you enrol.

05For teams

Build capability across your team

Bring a real system, a team challenge or a capability goal. We can tailor a workshop or map a learning path across the academies and courses. Explore team engagements, or contact us to discuss your needs.
